test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "efficiency."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The reason for using** "efficiency"** in the blank is to highlight the importance of performing duties with effectiveness, productivity, and proficiency.
 
• In the context of the sentence, civil servants are expected to adhere to a code of conduct that emphasizes not only impartiality and integrity but also the efficient execution of their duties.
 
• **"Efficiency"** implies the ability to accomplish tasks with minimal waste of time, resources, or effort while achieving the desired results. (वांछित परिणाम प्राप्त करते हुए समय, संसाधनों या प्रयास की न्यूनतम बर्बादी के साथ कार्यों को पूरा करने की क्षमता)
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph:

......Once they are appointed, civil servants are expected to abide by a code of conduct that emphasises impartiality, integrity and **efficiency**__ in carrying out their duties. Despite the challenges and demands of civil service work, it can be a highly rewarding career path, providing opportunities to make a positive impact on society and improve the lives of citizens. Whether working in a local, state or federal government agency, civil servants play a vital role in ______ (5) ______ democratic values and promoting the public good.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• **Activism: **the policy or action of using vigorous campaigning to bring about political or social change. (राजनीतिक या सामाजिक परिवर्तन लाने के लिए जोरदार अभियान चलाने की नीति या कार्रवाई)
 
• **Severity: **the quality or state of being severe. (गंभीर होने की गुणवत्ता या अवस्था)
 
• **Popularity: **the quality or state of being liked by many people. (लोकप्रियता)
